sloka: ततस्तेनैव कोपेन दशग्रीवः सहानुजः ।चिकीर्षुर्दुष्करं कर्म तपसे धृतमानसः ।। ७.९.४६ ॥
transliteration: tatastenaiva kopena daśagrīvaḥ sahānujaḥ ।cikīrṣurduṣkaraṁ karma tapase dhṛtamānasaḥ ।। 7.9.46 ॥

translations.english: Then, filled with that very anger, Dashagriva, along with his younger brothers, set his mind on performing a difficult penance.
